case.narrative: Was told by mechanic that my engine has a coolant leak and has caused engine failure.  The car has been jerking whenever I accelerate.  The remote start does not function from my key fob and I have been unable to pair the Ford pass app with that.  The USB ports for Android Auto also don't seem to work. If I drive over a small bump on the road, it disconnects my phone from Android Auto. I then have to unplug the cable then replug back into my phone or the USB port to hopefully get it to work again.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
